title: UI style presets (keys of ui_style_mock.luau PRESETS) with their style card
description: Derived from the styles data by scripts/export_design_pack.py --write-schemas: every key present today is required and typed. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere (minor versions add keys); readers ignore them.

strokeW.description: text stroke width in px, 0 for none

lip.description: color of the lip under the panel [r, g, b], null for none

header.description: header band gradient [[r, g, b] top, [r, g, b] bottom], null for no band

pills.description: colors of the small pills next to the title

rarityMode.description: how rarity is drawn: fill (card color, diagonal shade), line (bar over the price), tag (pill top-left)
